title: 2-Inch Solid Brass Robe Hook Wall Mount | Spanish Gold | Malibu Collection | Allied Brass
body_html:
Stop draping robes and towels over doors and counters in Spanish Gold, which presents a rich, warm golden tone with European-inspired elegance, bringing luxury and sophistication to distinguished bathrooms. The Malibu robe hook adds a dedicated, easy-to-reach hanging spot with a compact profile that suits transitional bathrooms.

  • Spanish Gold elevates the room with luxe gold tones
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Create a coordinated look with the Malibu robe hooks collection—designed as transitional bathroom hardware and versatile bath accessories
  • Match your bathroom hardware with multiple designer finish options available
  • Install with a clean, finished look using color-coordinated mounting hardware

Specs & Details
Dimensions (L x H x W): 2 in. x 2 in. x 2.64 in.
Box dimensions (L x H x W): 4 in. x 6 in. x 10 in.
Shipping weight: 1 lb.
Assembly: Assembled in the USA
Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
